Sorry about that. If an item you ordered is out of stock, we'll email you within 24 hours of the order with three options:

1. A similar plant of equal or higher value
2. Waiting up to 14 days for the original item
3. A refund for that item

Reply to that email with your choice. If we don't hear back within 3 days, the item is refunded automatically. If you haven't received the email, send me your order number (it looks like LF-123456) and I can help from there or escalate it.
